items.title: Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, 1997
items.q: I was talking to Ross Tompkins and we play this duo thing sometimes now and then

ctx.x: Well I’m going to let you get back to work, and see what you shake up this time with the crowd downstairs.

Okay. We’ve got a set coming up I think, I’m not the leader on the set but I think I got a little solo spot. And I was talking to Ross Tompkins and we play this duo thing sometimes now and then and so maybe we’ll play one of the tunes that we played in the past, maybe a Dizzy Gillespie tune if it’s all right with him.
Well it’s been a great pleasure for me, and a moment I’ve looked forward to.
